summary.text: Katy Tyndell is an attorney, business owner and civic leader who, by her own account, has spent two decades in independent oil and gas operations, small business and public policy. She is the Democratic nominee and describes her campaign as focused on affordability, bridging political divides and Congress's constitutional role.

paragraphs.text: Describes herself as an attorney, business owner, civic leader and mother of three with deep Kansas roots.

Says she has spent the past two decades in independent oil and gas operations, small business and public policy, with experience in federal government, non-profit advocacy and private enterprise, including advancing federal legislation and building bipartisan civic coalitions.
In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection submission she lists affordability, bridging the divide, and Congress and the Constitution as key messages.
